name: comp-167
blurb: Five emoji buttons for rating sentiment, one selected at a time.
description: Emoji-based sentiment selector with five expressions in a flex row. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use_when: Collecting quick feedback or satisfaction rating without imposing a numeric scale.
avoid_when: When precise numerical scoring is required or emoji meanings could be misunderstood culturally.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with hidden radio inputs, semantic labels, and focus-visible styling.
